When an agent runs your tests, the chat should show what a developer looks for: how far along it is, what failed and why. While tests run, Test Results shows a live “Running tests · 42 of 120” line with counts that tick digit by digit and a bar split into passed, failed and skipped. Tests stream into their files as they finish, and the file that’s running stays open.

When the run ends, the line turns into a past-tense summary such as “118 passed, 2 failed in 4.2s”. A clean run folds away. A failing one stays open with passing files folded and failing files open, unless you opened or closed them yourself. Each failure shows its message, a word-level Expected and Received diff and its stack through Stack Trace, with your frames first and framework frames folded. Timeouts and snapshot mismatches get their own wording.
